title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Right... Let me know if you need anything.

title: Talk 1
original: Watch out. There are a lot of dangerous materials in the workroom.

title: Talk 2
original: Engineering Department... Not bad. The head of the department, though... A bit too talkative.

title: Talk 3
original: I like machines. They don't talk, but they're always honest with their readings.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Chaos is only an enemy if you're unable to adapt.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: When the approaching chaos endangers your loved ones, the thing to do isn't to protect them. It's... to keep them as far away from you as possible.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: No, my comms equipment's fine. Nothing to worry.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: You want me to say something? Uh, that's the hardest part.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: My hometown? There... the sky is blue, and all the buildings under it are blue, too.

title: Idle
original: Good... I'll find something to do.

title: Onboard
original: Rainbow Operator, codename Fuze. I've said everything I need to. Let's get to it.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: No problem. I'll find some time to watch them.

title: Promotion 2
original: Do I need to give some crowd a speech? No? Good.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Focus on the task at hand.

title: 4-star Result
original: Every action builds our chances to win.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: On your feet, your wounds are not fatal.

title: Trust Tap
original: I made some pilaf. Want some?
